doc_structure: [{"node": "menu_content110", "element": "menu_content", "data": {"label": "Features", "key": "features_menu_content", "id": "features_menu_content", "name": "features_menu_content"}, "elements": [{"node": "markdown101", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Floor plan", "key": "md_feat_floor_plan", "id": "floor-plan", "name": "md_feat_floor_plan", "value": "# Floor plan - Floors, rooms and tables drawn to scale; drag, resize, round or square tables, seats and colors. - **Plan or list** view per device: table cards with search (table or guest) and filters *All, Free, Yours, Occupied, Reserved*. - Live status on every table: open orders, the customer, reservation held (time, guest, party size). - Production centers in a **Production** column (bottom bar on phones) with tickets by status and the oldest wait. - Phone layout with a floor picker; the screen remembers floor, room, table, order and panels after a reload. - Floor-plan editing by role, with rooms that can have their own menu."}}, {"node": "markdown102", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Orders", "key": "md_feat_orders", "id": "orders", "name": "md_feat_orders", "value": "# Orders - Several orders per table, tabs with item counts, customer, guests and an order note. - Catalog from the menu in force, in the menu's order, with search, dietary-tag filters and allergen chips. - **Options, sizes and combos** set on each item: components that are items (included or optional, with quantities and swaps), instructions for the kitchen, sections with required / maximum / free choices, shared Option Lists, ingredient modes per restaurant (Light, Extra, On the side), fixed price or price from components (see **Combos**). - **Sizes as ERPNext variants**: the template shows once ("from $3.49"), the waiter picks the size, each size has its own price, stock and recipe. - **Combos made of items**: a dish inside a combo offers its own options, a drink asks for its size, bigger sizes charge the difference. - **Option prices by size**: toppings that cost more on a large pizza (a factor per size, only in the sections you choose). - **Combos made in several stations**: each part goes to its own production center with its own status; the combo is ready when its last part is. - Line notes, quantities, discounts and price changes within the person's role, or with a manager PIN. - Send by rounds; each round is a new ticket for the kitchen. - Divide an order (by items) and transfer it to another table. - Voids with a reason; sent items need permission or a manager PIN; everything logged. - Phone order screen with a cart bar."}}, {"node": "markdown103", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Kitchen and bar", "key": "md_feat_kitchen_and_bar", "id": "kitchen-and-bar", "name": "md_feat_kitchen_and_bar", "value": "# Kitchen and bar - Unlimited **production centers** per floor (kitchen, grill, bar, coffee, expo…) by item group, with optional room, table or branch restrictions. - **Configurable statuses**: each one has how it is shown, the action that leads to it, a color and whether the server can still edit the line. - A flow per center; cards show the current status and the next action. Group by order or item by item. - Centers chained by status (coffee bar → expo), shared live with the server's order. - Rounds numbered per order, oldest first, server, guests and notes on every ticket. - Recall and undo, conflict detection when two screens tap the same ticket, voided items shown crossed out, sound on new tickets. - Thermal tickets per center (ESC/POS), including void tickets, with retry when a printer is off."}}, {"node": "markdown104", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Menus", "key": "md_feat_menus", "id": "menus", "name": "md_feat_menus", "value": "# Menus - Several menus per company; the restaurant's menu (the star), a menu per room and **scheduled menus** (breakfast, happy hour) that switch by the clock. - Menu prices per menu row, locked on the line once ordered. - **Menu Tags**: dietary tags and the US Big 9 allergens, editable, with catalog filters. - **86 / sold out** per restaurant, live on every screen; the server refuses new lines of it. - Optional rule: sell only what is on the menu in force. - Menu Manager to add or remove items, turn menus on or off and star the restaurant's menu."}}, {"node": "markdown105", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Reservations", "key": "md_feat_reservations", "id": "reservations", "name": "md_feat_reservations", "value": "# Reservations - Host stand: day summary, upcoming / seated / finished parties, search, late flag, guest history, tags and notes, timeline per table. - Available times from the server: tables, reservation hours (past midnight too) and **kitchen pacing** per time slot. - Table time by party size, combined tables, or no table yet. - Seat a party to open its order; paying completes the reservation; automatic no-shows after a grace period. - **Waitlist** with quoted times and a *table ready* SMS. - Confirmation and reminder emails and SMS. - **Online booking** at /reserve with automatic table assignment. - Rules per restaurant in Restaurant Reservation Settings."}}, {"node": "markdown106", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Payments and cash", "key": "md_feat_payments_and_cash", "id": "payments-and-cash", "name": "md_feat_payments_and_cash", "value": "# Payments and cash - Totals from ERPNext exactly as invoiced (POS Invoice or Sales Invoice), taxes included. - Several payment methods per check, cash suggestions and change. - **Tips**: suggested percentages, custom amount, on subtotal or total, recorded with the server. - **Split evenly** between guests, or by items with Divide. - **Stripe Terminal** card readers (WisePOS E, S700); a charge is never lost or doubled. - A **cash register per cashier**: opening float, live shift report, count the drawer and close with differences. - Receipts, bills with suggested tips and the cash drawer on thermal printers."}}, {"node": "markdown107", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Staff and permissions", "key": "md_feat_staff_and_permissions", "id": "staff-and-permissions", "name": "md_feat_staff_and_permissions", "value": "# Staff and permissions - **Restaurant Roles** with per-action permissions and a maximum discount; five roles installed. - Who works where: role, floors, rooms, tables and centers per person and POS Profile; grants add up across profiles of the same restaurant. - **Manager approval with PIN** on the spot, tied to the order and the amount, valid once. - **My access**: shows anyone the POS Profile, role and areas in use and why. - Clock in / out (optionally required), personal PINs, PIN login on registered shared terminals with lockout. - **Audit log** of approvals, discounts, price changes, voids, drawer openings, transfers and logins."}}, {"node": "markdown108", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Inventory and accounting", "key": "md_feat_inventory_and_accounting", "id": "inventory-and-accounting", "name": "md_feat_inventory_and_accounting", "value": "# Inventory and accounting - It is ERPNext: invoices, taxes, customers, stock, purchasing and every report. - **Recipes** on ERPNext BOMs: ingredients leave stock once per shift (register close or daily), adjusted by the options (no, light, extra, swaps); recipe cost on every dish. - Options linked to stock items are consumed with the dish; removed parts are not. - Theoretical usage from the recipes against your stock counts. - Price lists, pricing rules (applied only when set up by a manager) and coupons. - Multi-company and multi-restaurant: each POS Profile belongs to a restaurant."}}, {"node": "markdown109", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Technology", "key": "md_feat_technology", "id": "technology", "name": "md_feat_technology", "value": "# Technology - Frappe and ERPNext **v16**, Python 3.14. - React + Vite + Tailwind front end inside the Desk; works on computers, tablets and phones. - Real-time updates between every screen. - The server is the source of truth for prices, options, permissions and statuses. - Open source."}}]}]
